由调度协程转换为 FINISHED 或 FAILED。 type NodeFinishedEvent struct { NodeID string Output NodeOutput Err error } // DAGRuntime 保存一次 WorkflowRun 的内存调度上下文 // Runner 在 T1 提交后创建该结构；生命周期仅覆盖本次 Run，不能跨 run_id 复用 // EventCh 汇聚所有 worker 的完成事件。 type DAGRuntime struct { RunID string Graph *CompiledWorkflow States map[string]*NodeRuntimeState ReadyQueue []string Running int EventCh chan NodeFinishedEvent } // 的持久化与状态 CAS } // NodeTransition 是一次节点状态 CAS 的完整写入参数 type NodeTransition struct { RunID string NodeID string From ExecutionStatus // 数据库更新条件 To ExecutionStatus // 目标状态 Result Result BlockedBy Result Reason string } // WorkflowRunStore 隔离调度逻辑与 GORM/数据库实现 type WorkflowRunStore interface { // TransitionNode 仅在当前状态等于 From 时更新并返回 swapped=true // err != nil：数据库访问或事务执行失败，需要按数据库错误处理或重试。 // err == nil && swapped == true：状态转换成功，可以继续后续调度。 // err == nil && swapped == false：没有数据库错误，但节点当前状态已经不是 From，本次事件已经过期，应直接忽略。 TransitionNode(ctx context.Context, tx NodeTransition) (swapped bool, err error) // FinishWorkflow 在全部节点终态后写入 WorkflowRun 的最终状态和结果 FinishWorkflow(ctx context.Context, runID string, status ExecutionStatus, result Result, reason string) error } ``` - 各状态标识 - `FINISHED` 表示执行器正常返回，结果是： PASS、REJECT、UNKNOWN - `FAILED` 表示执行基础设施异常，结果固定为 UNKNOWN - `SKIPPED` 表示节点未执行，使用 `BlockedBy` 记录由 REJECT 或者 UNKNOWN 阻断 **前驱汇聚规则**：`join_type` 配置在目标节点上，默认值为 `AND`。 - AND 节点在全部前驱 PASS 后进入 READY，任一前驱 REJECT } if !swapped { continue } rt.Running++ // executeAndReport：异步调用对应 NodeExecutor，结束后向 EventCh 发送完成事件。 go s.executeAndReport(ctx, rt, nodeID) } if rt.Running == 0 && len(rt.ReadyQueue) == 0 { // scene.UpdateSceneStatusResponse UpdateSceneStatus(1: scene.UpdateSceneStatusRequest req) // 批量删除场景（根据场景ID） scene.DeleteTriggerSceneResponse DeleteTriggerScene(1: scene.DeleteTriggerSceneRequest req) QueryWorkflowRun(1: workflow.QueryWorkflowRunRequest req) } ``` ### 对内接口 #### `workflow.thrift` ```thrift include "../base.thrift" include "scene.thrift" typedef string WorkflowNodeType const WorkflowNodeType WorkflowNodeCondition = "condition" const WorkflowNodeType WorkflowNodeInference = "inference" typedef string WorkflowJoinType const WorkflowJoinType WorkflowJoinAnd = "AND" const WorkflowJoinType WorkflowJoinOr = "OR" typedef string WorkflowResult const WorkflowResult WorkflowResultPass = "PASS" const WorkflowResult WorkflowResultReject = "REJECT" const WorkflowResult WorkflowResultUnknown = "UNKNOWN" typedef string WorkflowExecutionStatus const WorkflowExecutionStatus WorkflowExecutionReady = "READY" // Node独有 const WorkflowExecutionStatus WorkflowExecutionPending = "PENDING" const WorkflowExecutionStatus WorkflowExecutionRunning = "RUNNING" const WorkflowExecutionStatus WorkflowExecutionFinished = "FINISHED" const WorkflowExecutionStatus WorkflowExecutionFailed = "FAILED" const WorkflowExecutionStatus WorkflowExecutionSkipped = "SKIPPED" // Node独有 union WorkflowNodeConfig { 1: scene.ConditionParams condition_params 2: scene.InferenceParams inference_params } struct WorkflowNodeInput { 1: required string node_id 2: required WorkflowNodeConfig config 3: optional WorkflowJoinType join_type // 前驱汇聚规则，未传时默认为 AND } struct WorkflowEdgeInput { 1: required string from_node_id 2: required string to_node_id } struct WorkflowDefinitionInput { 1: required string name 2: optional string description 3: optional i32 schema_version 4: required list nodes 5: required list edges } struct WorkflowValidationIssue { 1: required string code 2: required string message 3: optional string node_id 4: optional string field_path } struct RegisterWorkflowRequest { 1: required WorkflowDefinitionInput definition 255: base.Base Base } struct RegisterWorkflowResponse { 1: optional string workflow_id 2: required bool valid 3: optional list issues 255: base.BaseResp BaseResp } struct WorkflowDefinitionInfo { 1: required string workflow_id 2: required string name 3: optional string description 4: optional i32 schema_version 5: required list nodes 6: required list edges 7: optional string created_at 8: optional string updated_at } struct QueryWorkflowRequest { 1: required string workflow_id 255: base.Base Base } struct QueryWorkflowResponse { 1: optional WorkflowDefinitionInfo workflow 255: base.BaseResp BaseResp } struct WorkflowNodeRunInfo { 1: required string node_id 2: required WorkflowNodeType node_type 3: required WorkflowExecutionStatus execution_status 4: optional WorkflowResult result 5: optional string reason 6: optional string started_at 7: optional string finished_at } struct WorkflowRunInfo { 1: required string run_id 2: required string workflow_id 3: required i64 scene_id 4: optional list wake_signal_ids 5: optional string vehicle_id 6: optional string input_snapshot 7: optional string action_snapshot 8: optional string execute_policy_snapshot 9: required WorkflowExecutionStatus execution_status 10: optional WorkflowResult result 11: optional string reason 12: optional list node_runs 13: optional string history_execute_result 14: optional string started_at 15: optional string finished_at 16: optional string created_at } struct QueryWorkflowRunRequest { 1: optional string run_id 2: optional string workflow_id 3: optional i64 scene_id 4: optional string vehicle_id 5: optional WorkflowResult result 6: optional string start_time 7: optional string end_time 8: required i32 page_size 9: required i32 page_number 255: base.Base Base } struct QueryWorkflowRunResponse { 1: optional list runs 2: optional i64 total 255: base.BaseResp BaseResp } ``` `RegisterWorkflow` 内部执行完整校验。定义非法时返回 `valid=false` 和全部 `issues`，`workflow_id` 为空且不写数据库；定义合法时生成 `workflow_id = uuid()`，事务提交成功后返回 `valid=true` 和该 `workflow_id`。数据库或系统异常通过 `BaseResp` 返回失败，不与业务校验结果混用。 服务端根据 `config` union 当前设置的字段生成存储字段：`condition_params` 写入 `node_type=condition`，`inference_params` 写入 `node_type=inference`； `config_json` 只保存对应参数结构的 JSON 序列化结果。读取定义时根据数据库 `node_type` 反序列化并重建 union。 `join_type` 与节点定义一起写入 `trigger_workflow_node`，未传时服务端补为 `AND`；读取定义时原样重建 `WorkflowNodeInput`。Workflow 只允许一个终点节点，最终结果直接取该终点节点的有效结果。 #### `trigger.thrift` ```thrift include "workflow.thrift" service AIDVTriggerService { // 现有接口保持不变 // ... scene.UpdateSceneStatusForVehicleRequest UpdateSceneStatusForVehicle( 1: scene.UpdateSceneStatusForVehicleRequest req ) workflow.RegisterWorkflowResponse RegisterWorkflow( 1: workflow.RegisterWorkflowRequest req ) workflow.QueryWorkflowResponse QueryWorkflow( 1: workflow.QueryWorkflowRequest req ) workflow.QueryWorkflowRunResponse QueryWorkflowRun( 1: workflow.QueryWorkflowRunRequest req ) } ``` ### 新增接口Path POST /aidv/web/trigger/workflow GET /aidv/web/trigger/workflow GET /aidv/web/trigger/workflow/run # 上线方案 - [ ] 根据技术方案评审结论完善方案 - [ ] 启动开发 - [ ]
